axes.label: Accuracy
axes.description: Micro F1 over all expected and returned graded codes. A failed job counts as missed expected codes.

axes.label: Recall
axes.description: Share of gold codes that were returned, pooled across jobs.

axes.label: Precision
axes.description: Share of returned graded codes that are in the gold set.

axes.label: Provenance
axes.description: Share of returned codes whose snippet is verbatim in the encounter note after whitespace normalization.

axes.label: Safety
axes.description: Share of jobs with no forbidden code and no scope violation.

axes.label: Exact set
axes.description: Share of jobs whose graded code set exactly equals the gold set.

axes.label: History specificity
axes.description: Share of applicable jobs where every gold code that depends on history was returned. Null when no case requires history-specificity.

axes.label: Efficiency
axes.description: Bounded reference score: 0.5 x 60s/(60s+mean latency) + 0.5 x 4000/(4000+mean total tokens). Not a cost or quality measure.
